claims.text: The resort is a short walk from Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure Park and Downtown Disney District.

findings.quote: The resort is just a short walk from Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure Park, and Downtown Disney District

claims.text: A private pathway connects the hotel to Anaheim GardenWalk, with its outdoor dining and entertainment.

findings.quote: Just steps from our doors and easy to reach via our private pathway, Anaheim GardenWalk is the city’s epicenter of outdoor dining and entertainment.

claims.text: The hotel is a Disneyland Resort Good Neighbor Hotel and its concierge can help with multi-day Disneyland Resort Park Hopper tickets.

findings.quote: As a Disneyland Good Neighbor Hotel, we offer special vacation packages and can assist with multi-day Disneyland Resort Park Hopper® tickets through our concierge or online booking.

claims.text: The outdoor heated pool is open year-round and has luxury cabanas.

findings.quote: With an outdoor heated pool, open year-round, complete with three large luxury cabanas

claims.text: The resort grows its own herbs and produce in the JW Garden for use in dishes and drinks.

findings.quote: At our resort we grow our own herbs and produce for use in dishes, drinks, and more
Today, we grow fresh produce and herbs in our own JW Garden, which are used in recipes, cocktails, oils, and more.

claims.text: The JW Garden is also a Pollinator Garden of California native plants that support local wildlife.

findings.quote: Our garden also serves as a thriving Pollinator Garden, featuring California native plants that support local wildlife
the JW Garden reflects a deep-rooted family tradition
findings.note: garden named as the JW Garden

claims.text: Every room has a large walk-in shower with a stand-alone bathtub.

findings.quote: every room features a large walk-in shower with a stand-alone bathtub

claims.text: Some rooms and suites have views of the nearby theme parks.

findings.quote: Select rooms and suites offer trundle beds or bunk beds, perfect for accommodating little ones, while others boast enchanting views of the nearby theme parks.

claims.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and state-of-the-art equipment.

findings.quote: access to an expansive fitness center featuring Peloton bikes and state-of-the-art equipment

claims.text: A Yoga and Zen Room offers in-person and digital classes.

findings.quote: a rejuvenating Yoga and Zen Room featuring in-person and digital classes

claims.text: Tocca Ferro Italian Chophouse follows a seed-to-table philosophy, making dishes from scratch, including hand-rolled pasta and dry-aged beef.

findings.quote: rooted in a sustainable seed-to-table philosophy. Each dish is crafted from scratch, from hand-rolled pasta and dry-aged beef

claims.text: Family events run through the week, such as cookie decorating on Thursdays and movie nights on Saturdays.

findings.quote: family events take place throughout the week, like cookie decorating on Thursdays and movie nights on Saturdays.

claims.text: Parkestry Rooftop Bar & Lounge offers sweeping skyline views and, on select nights, views of the Disneyland fireworks.

findings.quote: At Parkestry Rooftop Bar & Lounge, our elevated outdoor oasis, take in sweeping skyline views as the evening unfolds—on select nights, culminating in Disneyland® fireworks lighting up the sky.

claims.text: Bunk Bed Suites have a twin-top and queen-bottom bunk so children get their own space.

findings.quote: For families, our Bunk Bed Suites offer a playful and practical setup featuring a twin‑top bunk and queen‑bottom bunk—giving kids their own cozy space

claims.text: The Family Bunkbed Suite can sleep up to six people in two separate bedrooms.

findings.quote: Families looking for even more room will love the Family Bunkbed Suite, which can sleep up to six people in two separate bedrooms.

claims.text: The tenth-floor Executive Lounge has a wraparound terrace with views over Anaheim and the nightly Disney fireworks.

findings.quote: Platinum, titanium, and ambassador Bonvoy members have full access to the tenth-floor Executive Lounge. Step onto the wraparound terrace for splendid views of the entire city of Anaheim and nightly Disney fireworks.

claims.text: Executive Lounge access is complimentary for Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite members; other guests need to book a room with lounge access.

findings.quote: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador Elite members receive complimentary lounge access during their stay.
Upgrade your stay by booking a room with an Executive lounge access (subject to availability)

claims.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.

findings.quote: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott, Anaheim Resort.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the location is busy during peak Disney seasons.
